name_reason: Name correctly reflects semantics and follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention: it is the church-revive main menu loop. Decompile confirms the revive payoff (rc[idx].flags = 0 to clear bit0=dead, then hp_current = hp_max full restore) and the sole caller fd2_run_chapter_intro_menu_typeC @ 0x3072F invokes it for cursor option 2 (labeled 復活 / revive). No Ghidra address residue in the name. The earlier mislabel as promote_menu_main (from the per-job fee table) was already corrected; current name is accurate.
purpose: Church-revive main menu loop: pick a dead party member, charge a per-level fee, then revive them (clear dead flag and fully restore HP).
logic_summary: Outer do-while loop. (1) fd2_build_dead_chars_list_for_revive(candidate_chars) -> dead_count; if 0, show 'no one is dead' dialog (FDTXT 0x24C) and return. (2) Show 'revive whom?' greeting (0x24D), run fd2_promote_members_select_loop(dead_count, candidate_chars); on Esc (-1) return. (3) chosen_idx = candidate_chars[cursor_idx]; set dialog substitution params: last_action_sprite_id = rc[chosen_idx].char_id + 1, last_action_value = rc[chosen_idx].status_flags_block[0] (level) * shop_inventory_full_dialog_text_id_table[rc[chosen_idx].job_id + 5] (per-job multiplier aliasing the table that follows the 6-entry shop dialog-id table @ 0x5265F). (4) Confirm 'pay X gold?' (0x24E); on yes (cursor 0) with enough gold: deduct via fd2_animate_money_decrement, rc[chosen_idx].flags = 0, rc[chosen_idx].hp_current = hp_max, redraw money panel, play revive fanfare (BGM 0x11) then ambient (BGM 0x0B), loop. Not enough gold -> show 0x1F8.

returns.semantics: No return value. Exits the menu loop (returns to caller) either when no party member is dead, or when the candidate picker is cancelled with Esc.

notes: Comment block for this function lives at promote.c lines 153-186 (orphaned from the body at line 964; it sits after the related fd2_promote_members_select_loop in the church-revive cluster). Comment is accurate and precise (verified: sole caller, per-level fee, flags=0 + hp_current=hp_max payoff, BGM 0x11/0x0B, price formula, the 0x5265F table aliasing, the __CHK(0x50) prologue note, and the EAX-tracking note about the three consumed return values), so kept unchanged. Field mapping confirmed via types.h + fd2-knowledge: status_flags_block[0] = level (+0x21), char_id = +0x08, job_id = +0x20, flags bit0 = dead (+0x05), hp_current/hp_max = +0x40/+0x42. The table[job_id + 5] access reads past the declared int16[6] shop dialog-id table @ 0x5265F into the adjacent per-job multiplier data; this is intentional vendor array overlap (faithfully reproduced, already documented in the comment), not a bug. Ghidra plate is consistent with the source comment, so left untouched.
